manaNeeded: {3}{U} and {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
When Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Lumbering Battlement to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Phantom Steed until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Lumbering Battlement and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Phantom Steed to return from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
